notes.title: Falcon returns home
notes.content:
Falcon has officially returned to MicroProse's line-up (you can read more at "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/microprose/announcements/detail/3680047495733505345]MicroProse is back on the Falcon series[/url]"), and as part of this new era we've made a few changes to the classic Falcon packages. For the original Falcon itself, you can now enjoy the following:
[list]

[*] Our classic games launcher, where you can comfortably change different options for a more accurate or nostalgic experience.
[*] The Tandy version of Falcon, which sports improved colors over the original CGA ones.
[*] New and improved documentation, a keyboard layout as well as the original quick reference card, with the full manual coming at a later date.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy these improvements as much as we did making them! We plan to continue improving the experience, so let us know if you have any feedback.
